notes: Corrected: 'and if' (t001-t002) and 'and that' (t034-t035) are each contiguous coordinator+subordinator pairs the ASV writes for a single waw whose clause it subordinates, so under rule 55 both words belong to the waw rather than the subordinator being added; the middle 'that' (t019) stands over a clause with no conjunction at all and remains added. Also moved the 'of' before 'every' onto כֹּל as the immediate rectum of מַשָּׁא.
